create.name: Bunny Michael
create.bio:
Bunny Michael is an artist, author and teacher whose work centres on what they call the Higher Self: the part of a person that already knows it is whole and worthy. Their own turn towards this way of seeing began in 2016, during a difficult period, and it grew out of the self-love memes they shared online before becoming a body of teaching. Alongside it they have made music, written and starred in a short web series, What Would Higher Self Do?, and hosted a talk show for Vice.

A key idea in their teaching is Learned Hierarchical Beliefs, a phrase they coined for the cultural measures by which some people are judged more worthy than others. Their book Hello Higher Self, published by Little, Brown in 2024, follows those beliefs through eighteen areas of life, from creativity and work to relationships, race and pleasure, with reflective exercises along the way. They offer one-to-one Higher Self coaching over Zoom, a monthly online gathering with talks, questions and shared journaling, and the XO Higher Self advice podcast. They have also led in-person retreats on creativity and inner work, including one at the Omega Institute.

videos.title: Your Breakup Is Your Awakening: the transformative power of heartbreak and how to let go

books.title: Hello Higher Self: An Outsider's Guide to Loving Yourself in a Tough World
books.author: Bunny Michael
books.description: Their first book, a guide to self-acceptance built around the idea of the Higher Self. It looks at how inherited ideas of worth show up in eighteen areas of life and pairs this with personal stories and written exercises.

courses.title: Higher Self Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one sessions on Zoom in which they help a client name the inherited beliefs behind a current struggle and look at it from the Higher Self's point of view. Each session ends with a plan for moving forward.
courses.price: Two 45 min coaching sessions on Zoom: $250; one 45 min session: $175

courses.title: Higher Self Healing Club
courses.description: A monthly online gathering for paid newsletter subscribers. Each meeting opens with a short talk on connecting with the Higher Self, then questions and two rounds of journaling and sharing, with recordings for those who miss it.
